aggregateVideoTachoZeroCrossTab.note: Cross-tab from frozen replay for buckets in video tacho-zero windows (no tacho values in DB export).

semanticsNote.stationarySupportedMeaning: QC V2 TRUSTED_LIMITED with motionState=STATIONARY_SUPPORTED and speedEvidenceState=STATIONARY_BAND — evaluates low-speed/stop band, not a guarantee of physical speed 0.
semanticsNote.rowAbsentMeaning: ROW_ABSENT in pinned POSITION snapshot — acquisition/sampling gap in S4 evidence, not auto-filled in replay.
semanticsNote.noMotionEvidenceMeaning: S1 motionState NO_MOTION_EVIDENCE — distinct from STATIONARY_SUPPORTED band acceptance.
